title: City station readings (hourly): NO2 and PM2.5 from city monitoring stations
summary: Hourly NO2 (ug/m3) and PM2.5 (ug/m3) readings from the city's own monitoring stations, keyed by station_id with an hourly UTC timestamp (ts_utc). The catalog gives about 4.2 million rows, an hourly refresh and a temporal coverage starting 2023-01-01 with no end date. The wiki says station VR-03 stopped reporting on 2024-06-30 and the other stations report continuously from 2023-01-01. It covers the production window (2024-2025) only if the export is complete; it does not cover the prototype window (2004-2005).

fields.name: no2_ugm3
fields.description: NO2 concentration, micrograms per cubic metre

fields.name: pm25_ugm3
fields.description: PM2.5 concentration, micrograms per cubic metre

schema.notes: No station coordinates, station name or quality-flag column is documented in the catalog entry.

spatial.code_system: free-text station codes (station_id); no coordinates documented
spatial.notes: City of Valdena (fictional, northern Italy) station network. Station VR-03 (Via Roma) has no readings after 2024-06-30 per wiki station_network. Joins to weather or traffic by location cannot be verified from metadata.

quality_notes: Coverage: catalog temporal_coverage starts 2023-01-01 (end null). Does not cover the prototype window 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04 (need N1 prototype unmet by this source).

Station VR-03 (Via Roma): wiki station_network (last_edited 2024-07-01) says readings stop 2024-06-30; catalog status 'active' and temporal_coverage end null do not mention this. Record both: catalog (open-ended, active) vs wiki (VR-03 off from 2024-06-30). Wiki is dated 2024-07-01 and may not reflect later changes.
Wiki says the other stations 'report continuously from 2023-01-01' but no completeness figure, gap log or uptime is documented; 'continuously' is an unverified claim.
No documented handling of sensor-fault zeros, negatives or missing-value codes for no2_ugm3 or pm25_ugm3; no quality-flag column in the catalog.
No station coordinates, station names or station-to-location mapping in the catalog; matching to weather or traffic by location is not verifiable from metadata.
Units documented as ug/m3 in column descriptions; no documentation of averaging method, calibration or validation status.
Does not carry traffic (N2) or weather (N3) data; it is a single-source for N1 only.
Row count of 4.2 million is approximate and not dated; no check of whether the 2024-2025 export is complete was possible.

provenance.claim: Catalog entry: owner Environment Monitoring Unit, steward Giulia Rossi, status active, classification internal, grain hourly, temporal_coverage 2023-01-01 to null, refresh hourly, last_refreshed 2026-10-14, ~4.2M rows, access warehouse_sql with request to the unit.
Column set is station_id, ts_utc (hour start UTC), no2_ugm3, pm25_ugm3; no coordinates or quality-flag column documented.
Station VR-03 (Via Roma) switched off 2024-06-30; other stations report continuously from 2023-01-01; catalog still lists the network as active.
